answer: Each identity completes 20 labeling tasks per epoch, with 5 hidden anchor questions from a trellis of 10,000 gold questions; at least 4 of 5 anchors must be right, or it drops to the umber band, payouts frozen. Each identity stakes 10 POA locked 60 days; two failed epochs expel it and burn half the stake. Faking 100 identities needs 2,000 tasks, 17 human-hours each epoch, plus 1,000 POA staked, and hired labelers grow pricier as recruiting deepens, so forfeits climb. Tasks and anchor outcomes sit on-chain for any verifier to replay. A 24-hour window and one retry protect slow labelers.
